# Unfold: Personal Bible Study

> Unfold is a Bible devotional app that helps Christians build a daily rhythm of Scripture, reflection, and prayer.

Product details reviewed September 23, 2026. Maintained by The Creative Co. Marketing Firm LLC.

- Official website: https://unfoldapp.co

- Founder: Nick Galang
- Founded: 2026, in Honolulu, Hawaii
- Support: support@unfoldapp.co
- Platforms: iPhone and iPad, iOS or iPadOS 16.4 or later. There is no Android or browser version.

Other products share the name Unfold. The website and App Store ID above identify this app. The App Store is the source for the latest released version, compatibility, and regional purchase prices.

## What Unfold does

Unfold builds a devotional series around a reader's spiritual life and what they want to explore. Each reading brings together Scripture, a devotional reflection, and questions for a personal response.

The app includes a full Bible reader, verse highlighting, guided reflection, prayer journaling, a companion for questions, and optional reminders. Premium adds further devotional series, audio narration, journaling, and reading customization.

Unfold includes 32 named study methods, including SOAP journaling, Inductive Study, Lectio Divina, and verse-by-verse study. See the full descriptions at https://unfoldapp.co/methods.

The Berean Standard Bible (BSB) and King James Version (KJV) are stored on the device for Bible reading without an internet connection. Preparing a new devotional requires a connection.

## Pricing

Unfold is free to download. The first devotional series and full Bible reader are included.

U.S. Premium pricing is $9.99 per month or $69.99 per year. Local prices may vary. A free trial is available to eligible new subscribers. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled and are managed through Apple at https://apps.apple.com/account/subscriptions.

See the current public offer at https://unfoldapp.co/#pricing.

## Team

Nick Galang built Unfold because he needed it himself as a new dad, during a season of life that felt like the wilderness. Unfold began in Honolulu in 2026. The full story is at https://unfoldapp.co/about#team.

## Privacy and support

Core devotional reading does not require an account. Gift features use optional Sign in with Apple. Gift sign-in does not synchronize devotional content between devices.

Devotionals, journal entries, notes, check-ins, and companion conversations are stored on the device and backed up to Unfold's server. Backups are encrypted in transit, not end-to-end encrypted. Unfold does not sell personal data or use advertising or ad tracking.

Optional features can send context or recordings to service providers. See https://unfoldapp.co/privacy for the current details on processing, diagnostics, gift accounts, and deletion. Contact support@unfoldapp.co for support or corrections.
